title: Canonical critical-capacity sockets, fixed-horizon margin form, and protected-row state

concepts.label: universal critical quotient supply
concepts.note: The open sharp quotient inequality over every finite below-half crossing core.

concepts.label: canonical half-greedy crossing core
concepts.note: The unique rational half-greedy prefix forced by an exact crossing.

concepts.label: actual skipped-orbit critical supply
concepts.note: The same critical quotient inequality restricted to ranks actually skipped by the half-greedy orbit.

concepts.label: pre-take precritical supply
concepts.note: The predecessor suffix bound restricted to a skipped rank immediately followed by a take.

concepts.label: fixed-horizon frozen margin
concepts.note: The exact carry coordinate at horizon c-3 representing the precritical suffix inequality.

concepts.label: protected exact row
concepts.note: A structured exact row carrying a protected core and strict endpoint-progress invariants.

concepts.label: finite-lookahead dyadic room
concepts.note: The elementary bound c-2<=2^(c-4) used inside the lookahead proof.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: SkippedCoreCriticalQuotientSupply is the open universal property requiring every finite below-half crossing core to reach the endpoint-(2c-2) integral half target after inserting the crossing rank c.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is a development-internal open predicate, not a novelty claim.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The property is defined, not proved; the completed consumer chain does not discharge it.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Every finite support below rank c satisfying the exact below-half and crossing-deficit hypotheses is equal to halfGreedyPrefixSupport (c-1).
statement_nodes.engine: superincreasing greedy-prefix rigidity at the first crossing
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: No external priority or novelty claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Uniqueness collapses the core search space but proves no critical quotient inequality and no half-membership.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: For every n, the rational Mersenne value of halfGreedyPrefixSupport n is strictly below one half.
statement_nodes.engine: odd-denominator parity for finite rational half-greedy prefixes
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is an elementary finite-prefix consequence.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Strict finite-prefix inequality does not imply convergence to one half or achievement-set membership.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: HalfGreedySkippedCriticalQuotientSupply is the open critical quotient lower bound restricted to ranks actually skipped by the rational half-greedy orbit.
statement_nodes.engine: actual-orbit restriction of the universal critical socket
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is a reduced open socket internal to the formal programme.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The predicate is not proved. Its equivalence with the universal socket does not establish either side.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: HalfGreedyPreTakePrecriticalSuffixSupply requires that at every skipped rank c at least six immediately followed by a take, the predecessor suffix at endpoint 2c-3 fits in c-3 bits.
statement_nodes.engine: last-skip-before-take restriction of the precritical suffix socket
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is an unproved development-internal supply predicate.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Defining the property does not assert it and does not assert that skip-then-take ranks occur cofinally.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: For c at least four, the endpoint-(2c-3) half-greedy prefix suffix fits in c-3 bits if and only if greedyHalfFrozenMargin (c-1) (c-3) is nonnegative.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: The theorem is an exact project-coordinate equivalence.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The equivalence proves neither side and is fixed-horizon rather than eventual first passage.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: The global half-greedy skipped precritical suffix supply implies HalfGreedySkippedCriticalQuotientSupply by advancing the exact endpoint recurrence once.
statement_nodes.engine: one-endpoint transport from the precritical suffix to the critical quotient
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is an internal reduction between open supply predicates.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The theorem transports an unproved supply and establishes neither supply unconditionally.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: ProtectedExactLocalMersenneRow is the structured exact-row state carrying a below-half protected core, support separation above its cutoff, endpoint bounds, the exact quotient identity, and rank-two membership.
statement_nodes.engine: state object preserving the invariants required for strict endpoint progress
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is proof infrastructure, not an independent existence theorem.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Declaring the structure proves neither arbitrarily many protected rows nor a successor; those consumers remain in Z29.

intra_zone_relations.basis: The existing theorem skippedCoreCriticalQuotientSupply_iff_halfGreedySkipped proves the two sockets equivalent after canonical-core reduction.
Crossing-core uniqueness explains why the universal finite-core socket reduces to the canonical half-greedy orbit.
Strict below-halfness makes the canonical prefix's below-half premise automatic in the reduction.
The fixed-horizon frozen-margin inequality is the exact coordinate form of the precritical suffix bound required at pre-take skipped ranks.
The existing pre-take equivalence identifies the global skipped suffix supply consumed by the theorem with the pre-take socket.
The exact conclusion of the transport theorem is HalfGreedySkippedCriticalQuotientSupply.
The protected-row structure is the consumer state whose conditional successor uses the universal critical supply; the structure itself proves no such supply.
